title: Programme Context
description: The timeline the feedback has to be read against. Stage 2 output. Without this the agent produces observations, not insights - a 58% confidence score means one thing eleven weeks out and another thing nine days out.

as_of.description: The date the brief speaks as of. All countdowns are measured from here.

methodology.description: e.g. 'waterfall, 3 stage gates' or 'agile, fortnightly releases' - changes what a readiness gap costs

milestones.description: Anything with a date that readiness feedback could change the plan for: go-lives, training waves, comms drops, decision gates, deliverable due dates.

segments.description: Which segments this milestone lands on. Empty = all.
The impacted population, named the way the programme names it. Drives the coverage matrix - a segment listed here with no feedback is a reported blind spot, not an absence.

name.description: Must match the 'group' value the source adapters emit
